newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-NEWE ZEALAND SNATCH VICTORY OVER SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NEWE ZEALAND SNATCH VICTORY OVER SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: The New Zealand All Blacks snatched a dramatic 35-32 victory to deny a committed South Africa team in a Tri-Nations match at Ellis Park on Saturday.

A furious Springbok surge in the last five minutes could not breach the All Black defence and fly-half Jannie de Beer hit the post with a penalty two minutes from time to spoil an otherwise immaculate kicking display in which he dropped two goals from the halfway line and notched 14 points from spot kicks.

The All Blacks deserved their victory, scoring four tries to two and coming back from a 23-7 deficit after 30 minutes. Veteran centre Frank Bunce scored two of their tries and Carlos Spencer and Jeff Wilson one each.
The Springboks dominated the first half an hour, scoring tries through hooker Naka Drotske and full-back Russell Bennett.
With De Beer kicking goals from everywhere, an unlikely home win seemed on the cards. But it was not to be.
